```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r, read in scenario outputs}

simPar <- read.csv("data\\samsim pars\\SimPars.csv")
CUPar <- read.csv("data\\samsim pars\\CUPars.csv")

hcrDatalist<-list()
srData<- list()
for(a in seq_len(nrow(simPar))){
  
  
   hcrDatalist[[a]] <- readRDS(paste0("./outputs/SamSimOutputs/simData/",
   simPar$nameOM[a],"/", 
   simPar$scenario[a],"/",
   paste(simPar$nameOM[a],"_", simPar$nameMP[a], "_", "CU_HCR_PM.RData",sep="")))$hcrDatout

   hcrDatalist[[a]]$scenario<-simPar$scenario[a]
   hcrDatalist[[a]]$nameOM<-simPar$nameOM[a]
   hcrDatalist[[a]]$nameMP<-simPar$nameMP[a]


   srData[[a]] <- readRDS(paste0("./outputs/SamSimOutputs/simData/", 
                         simPar$nameOM[a],"/",
                         simPar$scenario[a],"/",
                         paste(simPar$nameOM[a],"_", simPar$nameMP[a], "_", "CUsrDat.RData",sep="")))$srDatout


  srData[[a]]$scenario<-simPar$scenario[a]
  srData[[a]]$nameOM<-simPar$nameOM[a]
  srData[[a]]$nameMP<-simPar$nameMP[a]
}

hcrdat <- do.call(rbind,hcrDatalist)
srdat<- do.call(rbind,srData)

hcrdat<-hcrdat[hcrdat$year>50,] #remove burn-in period
srdat<-srdat[srdat$year>50,]

#hcrdat maybe not needed - has catch statistics though
hcrdat=hcrdat[order(hcrdat$scenario,hcrdat$iteration,hcrdat$CU,hcrdat$year),]
srdat=srdat[order(srdat$scenario,srdat$iteration,srdat$CU,srdat$year),]

```
